title: 2024 AMC 8 Problem 8
statement: On Monday Taye has \(\$2.\) Every day, he either gains \(\$3\) or doubles the amount of money he had on the previous day. How many different dollar amounts could Taye have on Thursday, \(3\) days later?

solutions.text:
After Tuesday, Taye could have \(5\) or \(4\) dollars. After Wednesday, the possible amounts are \[ 8,10,7,8, \] so the distinct amounts are \(7,8,10\).

After Thursday, these can become \[ 10,14,\quad 11,16,\quad 13,20. \] These are \(6\) distinct dollar amounts.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
